name: commerceops
description: A deterministic commerce operations application designed as a realistic system under test.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@commerceops/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@commerceops/api && npm run build --workspace=@commerceops/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@commerceops/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@commerceops/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@commerceops/web"
